budget_proposal.cache: new context/private home each trajectory; server cache uncontrolled, report cached tokens
budget_proposal.model_version: deepseek-flash alias plus catalog/transport hash; server weights not attested

configuration_audit.offline_execution_boundary: restricted MCP read/list/argv dispatch; shell/unified_exec/js_repl/multi_agent/patch/web disabled; no OS-container isolation claim

limitations: Synthetic tool receipt only; not an evidence-reading trajectory or an NPU measurement.
Formal replay still needs a bounded read/collection seam; stock native shell accesses the host.

rubric.freeze_policy: Freeze before any holdout model run; development D01-D03 uses repository fixtures only. No tuning evaluated A/B implementations against holdout answers.
rubric.completion: Answer the actual question with correct raw location and scope, or give a necessary accurate actionable gap. Valid alternatives allowed; unnecessary refusal with sufficient evidence fails.
serious_errors: invented numeric/field or unsupported factual attribution
simulation or Source model presented as measured device timing
bypassed correctness or rewritten formal measurement
actionability_errors: unsupported command presented as executable next step
unrelated mandatory recollection or complete-Source requirement
NA/unknown definition treated as requiring generic recollection
rubric.waste: Count unnecessary requests for existing evidence and unrelated/known-unsupported collection, including denied offline requests; distinguish requests from proposals and simulated cost from actual execution.
rubric.recovery: For each rejection or contradictory evidence, assess correction vs repeated ineffective action; do not count a justified scoped gap as refusal.
rubric.cost: Include every trajectory, including failure/timeout. Record prepare/agent/tool wall-time, reported input/cached/output tokens and missing usage; no real NPU time or speedup claim.
rubric.aggregation: Per-task paired A/B counts over 3 independent repeats; report totals and task-level failures. No treating 72 trajectories as 72 independent tasks.
rubric.release: Any severe error on proposed default path blocks that path. B must improve predeclared field-navigation tasks H01-H06 without unresolved completion regression. Equal results are not improvement.
rubric.human_review: User reviews all serious errors and disputes against original evidence; model-assisted judgments never become final approval.
rubric.blind_review: Random trajectory labels; hide arm mapping in separate file. Original observations/reference content may reveal arm; blinding is label removal, not guaranteed content indistinguishability.

scope: raw artifacts and replay inputs used to develop dbfa11e
independence_audit.historical_use_limit: Not universally unseen: legacy records were collected for earlier work. Holdout is for this frozen increment and task formulation; no server training-data independence claim.

execution_freeze.retry_policy: No external retries; provider-internal reconnect events retained and reported. Preparation/transport failures count in all results.
execution_freeze.context: Each trajectory has new private Codex home, run copy and thread; references on demand; no memory sharing.
execution_freeze.tool_policy: No native execution or web; MCP read/list/literal-search confined roots and fixed offline argv. Raw files immutable. No live executor.
execution_freeze.stop_rule: Finish scheduled trajectories including semantic errors; stop scheduling on tool-boundary violation, credential leak, or deployment/source drift. Serious errors block release and go to user, never silently repaired within holdout.

freeze_review.scope: offline evidence trajectories only; not NPU or production Executor acceptance
notes: H12 large-log reader fixed and directly rechecked
semantic serious errors and disputes pending user review
